novel_features.name: Awaiting reply
novel_features.description: See every thread where someone is waiting on your answer, across all accounts, oldest first.
novel_features.rationale: Requires reconstructed threads joined with your identities, localized Sent folders and Thunderbird's replied flag, which only exist together in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when asked what mail still needs a reply instead of scanning recent messages.

novel_features.name: Correspondents ranking
novel_features.description: Rank the people you exchange mail with by volume and recency, and spot frequent ones missing from your address book.
novel_features.rationale: Joins inbound and outbound messages with your identities and address-book cards in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to answer who someone is to the user and when they last talked.

novel_features.name: Filters audit
novel_features.description: Check every message filter: how often it matches, whether it is disabled, and whether its target folder still exists.
novel_features.rationale: Parses Thunderbird's msgFilterRules.dat and evaluates rules against the locally indexed mail.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when mail lands in the wrong folder or to clean up dead filter rules.

novel_features.name: Largest items
novel_features.description: Find the biggest messages or attachments across all accounts and folders.
novel_features.rationale: Ranks by on-disk mbox size and decoded attachment size, which no single folder view exposes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to free disk or mailbox quota.

novel_features.name: Newsletters and bulk senders
novel_features.description: List mailing lists and bulk senders by volume and how much of their mail you never read.
novel_features.rationale: Combines List-Id headers with Thunderbird's read flags from the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to pick unsubscribe candidates.

narrative.headline: Search, read and audit the mail Thunderbird already downloaded — offline, read-only, no credentials.
narrative.value_prop: Indexes your Thunderbird profile (mbox stores, address book, filters) into a local full-text store you can query while Thunderbird is running. Adds what no other Thunderbird tool has: awaiting-reply, correspondent ranking, filters audit and bulk-mail triage.
narrative.auth_narrative: No authentication. The CLI reads your local Thunderbird profile read-only and never touches passwords, key4.db or logins.json. It auto-detects the default profile; override with --profile or THUNDERBIRD_PROFILE.

quickstart.comment: Check that the profile is found and readable
Index mail, contacts and filters into the local store
Threads still waiting on your answer

troubleshoots.fix: Pass --profile <path to profile dir> or set THUNDERBIRD_PROFILE
Enable offline sync for that folder in Thunderbird (Folder Properties > Synchronization), then run sync again

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent needs to find, read, summarize or triage the user's email that Thunderbird has stored locally, without IMAP credentials. It is safe to run while Thunderbird is open and never modifies the profile. Run `sync` first (and again to pick up new mail): search and the audit commands read the local store, which only holds folders Thunderbird keeps for offline use.
anti_triggers: Sending, moving, flagging or deleting mail — drafts open prefilled in Thunderbird and you press Send yourself
Mail in folders Thunderbird has not synced for offline use
Webmail-only accounts not configured in Thunderbird

recipes.explanation: Prints the prefilled reply fields and the thunderbird -compose command line; add --open to open the compose window. Nothing is ever sent.
